limits: RSS sum double-counts shared pages; use PSS where available

coverage.remote_model_or_ssh_work: Not included unless measured separately or represented by explicit local PID/cgroup scope. A local client/gateway alone does not measure remote inference.

cpu.short_lived_unobserved_process_cpu: missing unless included by a baselined, retained cgroup CPU counter; never assumed zero

scope: One persistent lane; local descendant tree plus discovered runtime cgroups, with explicit gaps
